transparency.title: How KALATI works
transparency.p1: KALATI is a document assistant. It retrieves passages from CAMRAIL internal documentation, then writes an answer grounded exclusively in those passages. No data leaves the internal network.
transparency.p2: Answers are generated by artificial intelligence and may contain errors. Verify them against the cited sources before any binding decision.
transparency.p3: You will only see answers grounded in documents your grade and department allow. When the sources are insufficient, KALATI declines to answer rather than inventing content.
transparency.p4: Every interaction is logged (timestamp, grade, department, hashes of the question and answer) in a chained, verifiable register.
transparency.banner: AI-generated answers based on CAMRAIL documentation. Verify against the cited sources before any binding decision.

quality.title: Answer quality
quality.faithfulnessHelp: Share of the answer's claims directly grounded in the source passages.

quality.contextPrecisionHelp: Share of retrieved passages that are genuinely relevant.

guide.title: Asking KALATI a good question
guide.lead: Four principles that markedly improve answer quality.
guide.p1: Rather than "notice period", write "notice period for a supervisory agent under the Collective Agreement". A precise documentary context makes retrieval more precise.
guide.p2: A multi-hop question can be asked as a sequence of simple ones, whose successive answers build the full reasoning.
guide.p3Title: Make use of the calibrated refusal
guide.p3: A refusal means the information is not available in the KALATI corpus at your clearance level. Contact the relevant department, or check that the document is actually filed in KALATI.
guide.p4: Every answer carries its source references (document, section, article, page). For any high-stakes operational use, consult the original source in KALATI.
guide.limitsBody: KALATI answers in a closed world over the portal's corpus. It produces no outside knowledge and refuses rather than inventing.
